installCommand: echo 'no install step — Flutter is fetched in buildCommand'
buildCommand: if [ ! -x flutter/bin/flutter ]; then rm -rf flutter && git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b 3.44.1 --depth 1; fi && flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=$API_BASE_URL
